notes.title: 1.2 Patch - lots of bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Here are the patch notes for version 1.2, out now on PC/Mac and Switch (Full game & Demo)

We've been fixing a bunch of smaller bugs after the release! As work on the new content is starting, expect frequency of patches to slow down :) 



As always, don't hesitate to get in touch via mail/forum/discord if you have any issue with the game! Thanks everyone for your support.



Here are some of the notable changes, you can find the Full patch notes here


Fixes: 
\[Puzzles] Fixed the "Force separator spacing to 5" working incorrectly on 16 sized puzzles 

\[Stickers] Stickers are now saved and loaded in the correct order. Your previous layout will possibly need adjustments 

\[Costumes] Fix color variations for the following costumes: Pirate Mustache/Hat/Scarf, Angel Wings/Disc

\[House] Fix color variations for the following items: Washer Dryer combo, Fancy Fridge 
Changes: 
\[List View] Overall navigation & sorting improved 

\[UI] "Main Menu" title disappear after a few seconds, more space for stickers! 

\[House] Decor Browser: Side Bar navigation improved 

\[Puzzle] Cone of Shame magically scales down when starting a Squeakross to prevent overlap with the grid 
New: 
\[List View] List view now displays best times



Thank you! 



FULL PATCH NOTES



-Alex

notes.title: Upcoming bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!



Just to let you know what we're currently working on:



SWITCH: We're waiting for Nintendo (😩)  to approve a patch that fixes infinite puzzle loading and rodent images not loading. 

Reminder that you can fix the loading issue by turning off "Auto-Cross empty lines at start"

STEAM: The next patch will contain the following fixes:

[Auto-Cross completed lines] will work correctly and be more robust. Auto placed crosses will have a slightly different color to help you keep track of them.

Mouse precision at high speed will be improved: you won't be able to overshoot with auto cross complete on, for example! 

Fix for achievements not being granted (especially the Furniture Sets achievements). They will be given retroactively when opening the game again.

We're also working on a system to create a save backup. Steam cloud seems to be notorious for, on very rare occasions, corrupting your save. I encourage you to back it up manually! Save location is "%appdata%/../LocalLow/Alblune/Squeakross"

A previously non-copyrighted music track is now copyrighted. We removed it from the streamer mode playlist.

You can expect that patch next week.

Once we're done with this, we'll start working on fixing the many minor bugs reported! Most of them are related to house decoration and stickers!

We'll also start adding some requested QoL like being able to start from the top-left corner (and many more)! 





Please keep in mind that the Switch version will receive updates at a slower pace because of how heavy the patching process is on that platform. 


We also passed 10K units sold! Thanks everyone for the support! News about free content update coming soon! 


Thank you, and don't forget to take a break...some of you are too addicted.... 😳

notes.title: [DEMO] Version 1.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

New demo update! We've been hard at work on the game, and it's time to make sure the demo reflects the full game! If you look at the release number, you'll probably guess that release is not that far 😏

Patch notes:

Changes/New Features - PUZZLE :

 Adjusted Puzzle UI for better readability
 You can display a "Reference sheet" in game
 Manual Scribbling of hints updated, can be done with a controller
 Reduce Hint zoom to avoid going offscreen. Enable zoom by default for large puzzles
 Tons of new music (with funny titles) + ability to skip the current track in the pause menu.
 When winning a costume's challenge puzzle, you will try on the displayed color variation
 Suspend limit added: You can only suspend up to 5 puzzles at a time per catalog


Changes/New Features - RODENT EDITOR:

 New patterns, and updated existing patterns
 Dual eyes colors option
 Paw fur
 Missing eyes
 New whisker color option


Changes/New Features - HOUSE:

 House Camera controls completely redone for controller!
 "NEW" notification for unlocked decor/costumes
 You can toggle the time on/off in Photo mode
 Red placement indicator for blocked placement
 Improve Wallpaper/Ground selection
 Many rodent reactions added (Limited in the demo!)
 Added brain cells the rodent AI, it should be (a tiny bit) more intelligent


Changes/New Features - OTHERS:

 Save location was changed! There is now one save per user on the same 
computer
 List view UI rework. Suspended puzzles appear on top 
 Catalog navigation dots will show an [⏸] icon on pages with suspended puzzles
 LANGUAGES ADDED: French, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Spanish


Bugfixes:

 Fix hints issue when resuming a suspended puzzle 
 Catalog pages can be scrolled by holding a key
 The catalog opens at the right page when giving up or suspending a puzzle
 Fix Logic-Assist messing up the Undo/redo buffer
 Fix an issue where controls were stuck for a few seconds at the beginning of tutorial#2
 Typos, Text fixes,...


There are few more stuff not shown here, as it would be spoiler for the full game 🤓

-Alex
